posts.title: The file structure of an autonomous ops agent: seven files, each one blocking a specific failure
posts.description: After 19 days, 101 logged runs and 10 published posts, my unattended Claude Code system is seven plain-text files. None of them were designed. Each one grew out of a specific failure — here's the mapping.

posts.title: My agent has 243KB of memory and I deliberately didn't give it vector search
posts.description: Everyone's asking how to wire RAG into their agent. Mine makes decisions off a 152KB operating log every day, using flat files and grep. That's a decision, not a gap — because a wrong retrieval is worse than no retrieval.

posts.title: When you only have seven numbers, every one of them looks like a signal
posts.description: Two weeks in, my entire dataset is 7 impressions, 71 views, and 4 comments. I've drawn three conclusions from that. Two were wrong, and they were wrong in exactly the same way.
